title: Ace Combat 8 smashes the series' Steam record ✈️
subject: acecombat
description:
Are you flying in Ace Combat 8? 👇

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve peaked at more than 52,000 concurrent players on Steam in its first weekend, almost 4 times Ace Combat 7's 13,758. It holds an 87 on OpenCritic, though PC players report performance issues.

Sources: OpenCritic (Oct 4, 2026), Notebookcheck, GamingBolt
Game footage © Bandai Namco Entertainment.

scenes.text: Ace Combat 8 just shattered the series' Steam record.
Wings of Theve hit more than 52,000 concurrent players on Steam in its first weekend.
Ace Combat 7's best on Steam was 13,758, so that's almost 4 times higher.
Critics are on board too, with an 87 on OpenCritic.
It's not all smooth: PC players report frame rate problems, and the Ace Combat Zero pre-order bonus only runs with Ace Combat 8 installed.
